description: Configure the Magento Admin Security settings to strictly enforce security policies. Navigate to Stores > Configuration > Advanced > Admin > Security. Set 'Password Lifetime' to 90 days. Set 'Password Change' to 'Forced'. Set 'Maximum Login Failures to Lockout Account' to 5. Set 'Lockout Time' to 30 minutes. Set 'Admin Session Lifetime' to 1800 seconds (30 minutes). Click 'Save Config' to apply the changes. If not logged in, use admin/Admin1234!.
